text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've finally made it to the battlefield
that will
determine the greatest
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Palpable! Hearing these cheers makes it

exceptionally clear that cooperating in
this race
series was absolutely necessary!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your partner has already made her way
to the
track, I see! I hoped to wish her
luck, but it
appears I was a step too
slow!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm here to cheer on all the

Umamusume participating today!
choice_data_list: 応援ありがとうございます

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Come victory or defeat—this will be the
ultimate
climax! Now, it's time to race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the first race in the series, and the
first
step towards the title of "greatest"!
